answer: An operator running 231 keys thus pays for 231 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the walnut quota and the falcon admission check. Since the throttle counters live in the river ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. Challenge issue is rate limited to 12 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole farm at once. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
